title: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation
line: White's knight guards the center from behind; Black hits White's pawn chain twice.

steps.text: Here White guards the pawn on e4 with the knight on d2. It keeps c3 free for a pawn that will back up d4.
Bring the knight out to attack the pawn on e4.

also.c7c5: That is the other main answer. This lesson goes on with the knight.

steps.text: White's pawn kicks your knight. Step back to d7.
Push the pawn on c7 two squares to hit the base of White's chain.
Bring the other knight out. It is another attacker on d4.
Now push the pawn on f7 one square. It hits the head of the chain, the pawn on e5.
steps.after: Both ends of White's chain are under attack: your pawn hits e5 and your knight hits d4.

summary: In the Tarrasch, Black's pawns hit White's chain twice: first at its base, then at its head.
